card.name: Time units after a number
card.fires_on: Time-unit words such as months, hours, weeks, days or month right after a number, usually when describing onset, duration or spacing of events.

modes.label: Windows and intervals
modes.description: Unit word after a number giving a window or spacing between doses or events.
modes.example: For all routes of administration, begin NYMALIZE within 96<< hours>> of the onset of SAH.

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce month and week style time units, especially month-scale ones.
card.plain: It fires on the time unit after a number, like months or hours, when a label says how soon or how often something happens.
